about: What a vehicle package may hold (#530; docs/vehicles.md, Packages). Read by the game's check at install and at startup (src/packages.js) and by tools/test_vehicles.py for the repository's vehicles: one description for both.
interface_about: The vehicle interface's version (docs/vehicles.md): what a package's `game` is compared with. The major number grows when a field, slot, event or rig name a package uses changes its meaning or goes; the minor when one is added. 1.1 (#525): the rig names its headlights, tail lamps and saloon by node (`headlights`, `tailLamps`, `saloon`); 1.0's points and boxes are still read. 1.2 (#590): lineContactor.close/open and the optional lineContactorRelease gain curve; generic lineContactor remains a fallback. 1.3 (#636): a sound pack's events and loops may name Ogg (Opus) files, each with an MP3 `fallback` among its files.
id_about: author.package, in lower case: two authors never collide
reserved_about: names the id's pattern allows that the browser's store keeps for itself (packages/index.json, the installed list)
path_about: a listed file's path in its package: folders by /, each name of letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens and spaces, starting with a letter, a digit or an underscore. Names are shown on the loading screen and become file names in the browser's store, so nothing else is taken
caps_about: bytes: a package's files together, and one file of each class; `archive`: a .zip's own bytes and what its directory says it unpacks to (a bundle of packages: four at the package cap), `entries`: the files in an archive, a picked folder or a manifest's list. An archive is refused by these before anything is unpacked, and an address before more than them is read (#713)
image_about: px: an image's longer side at most this (refused at install); a livery's textures have power-of-two sides (tools/test_vehicles.py holds the repository's to the same)
sound_about: a sound file plays at most maxSeconds (decoded at install; an Ogg this browser cannot decode is left to its MP3 fallback); a pack's and a loop's `gain` lies between 0 and maxGain (src/audio.js clamps it too)
licences_about: licences that allow the files to be redistributed with the game (ASSETS.md); NC ones not in a commercial release
loaders_about: the loaders an installed vehicle may name: the built-in car and the classic model are the game's own
moves_about: what a vehicle's `moves` may claim (docs/vehicles.md, Tiers of movement); the rig's names each needs: src/rigged.js rigProblems
budget_about: one car at its full level, as the game draws it (the hybrid T3, assets/t3h/: 43,612 triangles and 62 draw calls). Wide for now, to see what authors bring (maintainer, 2026-11-13)
fit_about: m: one car's box. Refused: longer than maxLength (maintainer, 2026-11-13: room for long single-model trams), wider than its type (src/tram.js VEHICLE_TYPES) plus widthOver (mirrors), its lowest point more than railLow below or railHigh above the rail plane (the wheels' flanges reach below it). Warned: longer than its type's length over the coupler faces plus lengthOver (it runs on its type's pivots until a type of its own exists, #579)
